anchors.note: Oct 3 Base anchor of epoch 1. Fill tx with the 32-byte transaction hash before restart. Boot refuses while tx is null.
Oct 5 Base anchor of the epoch 2 opening root. Fill tx before restart.
Oct 5 Solana memo signature for the epoch 2 opening root. Fill tx before restart.

note: Boot recomputes every pinned epoch from the journal. anchor-state.json is not evidence. Known anchor transactions are loaded with eth_getTransactionByHash (Base) or getTransaction (Solana).
